findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_flights, open_flight_link, search_hotels, hotel_rooms · Private data: open_flight_link, my_account, claim_flight_offer, claim_hotel_quote · Public sink: search_hotels, hotel_rooms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_flights, open_flight_link, search_hotels, hotel_rooms · Private data: open_flight_link, my_account, claim_flight_offer, claim_hotel_quote · Public sink: search_hotels, hotel_rooms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
